title: E-FRC-0188: binding needs pair creation, derived: the paid Z3 string whose vacuum makes pairs is the 3-state Potts...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0188 in the gauge arena: binding needs pair creation, derived: the paid Z3 string whose vacuum makes pairs is the 3-state Potts model in a magnetic field (exact on a D4 patch), so without pairs two static color singlets (stand-ins for nucleons) are exactly unjoined on the line and with pairs they attract at the dressed meson's own mass, the line's static baryon is inert, and the leading-order D4 profile gives the predicted meson mass.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
